Metadata.title: IxMaOperations — Contract Automation Work
Metadata.description: Pick a pre-scoped automation package or bring a custom project — submit a request and get a price and timeline back. Lead scraping, OCR pipelines, content repurposing, data auditing, API integrations, and custom vision models.

Footer.tagline: Automation and AI tooling — tell me what you need, I'll reply with scope and a time to talk.

Hero.title: Custom automation and vision pipelines, built by the engineer you'll actually talk to.
Hero.description: I'm Emilio Ramirez. Tell me what's eating your team's time — scraping, documents, data QA, integrations, custom vision — and I'll reply with real scope and a time to talk. You own the code, the docs, and any model I train.

HomeScoper.title: Describe the job, see the scope
HomeScoper.description: Pick the problem and how you want it handed off. The scope sheet fills in as you go — then send the brief or book a call. Or, if you'd rather skip this, <emailLink>email me directly</emailLink>.

Examples.title: What this looks like when it's built
Examples.description: A quick look at each skill area — click through for the real, working pipeline.

scraper.emptyState: Enter a public URL above, or pick one of the samples, to run the real pipeline against it.

ocr.dropHint: Drop a receipt or invoice image here
ocr.browseHint: or click to browse — PNG or JPEG
ocr.emptyState: Upload a receipt/invoice photo, or pick a sample, to run real OCR — tesseract.js, right in your browser.
ocr.enhancedHint: Shown enhanced for OCR (grayscale + contrast) — this is what the engine actually read.
ocr.hoverHint: Hover a box to see the detected word and its confidence.
ocr.lineItemsHint: (editable — fix a misread, or add a row by hand)
ocr.noLineItems: No line items detected — add one manually, or try another image.

content.inputPlaceholder: Paste an article, video transcript, or raw notes…
content.emptyState: Paste some text above, or pick a sample, to see the real pipeline turn it into platform-ready drafts.
content.truncatedNote: Input was trimmed to the first 20,000 characters for this demo.

audit.inputPlaceholder: Paste CSV or tab-separated rows, with a header row (Name, Email, Phone, Date, …)…
audit.emptyState: Paste a CSV/spreadsheet export, upload a file, or load the sample dataset to run real validation — email syntax + typo correction, E.164 phone normalization, ISO-8601 dates, and duplicate detection, all in your browser.
audit.healthScoreHint: Errors count fully against it; warnings and auto-fixed values count partially.
audit.noIssues: No issues detected — this dataset is clean.

integration.inputPlaceholder: Paste a webhook JSON payload — Stripe, Shopify, or a custom CRM lead…
integration.emptyState: Paste a webhook payload above, or pick a sample, to run it through the real pipeline — ingestion, field mapping, condition routing, and downstream dispatch-payload generation.
integration.sectionDispatch: Downstream Payload Dispatch (generated — nothing is actually sent)

step.notAnObject: Expected a JSON object, not an array or primitive.
step.ingestUnknown: Shape not recognized — falling back to generic field detection.
step.routeEnterprise: Amount (${amount}) exceeds ${threshold} — routed to Enterprise VIP.
step.routeNoAmount: No amount detected — routed to Standard.

vision.browseHint: or click to browse — PNG or JPEG
vision.emptyState: Upload a photo, or pick a sample, to run real object detection — a pretrained COCO-SSD model, right in your browser.
vision.modelNote: General-purpose object detection — YOLOX-S (Apache-2.0, Megvii), 80 COCO classes: people, vehicles, animals, furniture, everyday objects — not a custom-trained inspection model. Crowded scenes, overlapping objects, and props/costumes that hide identifying features are the hardest case for this kind of model, and misclassifications are more likely there.
vision.lowConfidenceAdvisory: Even the model's best guess on this image scored below 70% — this scene is harder than usual (crowding, occlusion, or clutter). Treat these results as tentative, or try a simpler photo.
vision.fpsHint: Est. FPS is a throughput estimate from this image's own inference time, not a sustained video benchmark.
vision.modelLoadHint: Model Load Time is a one-time cost (downloading + initializing the model) — excluded from Inference Latency and shown only on the first run.
vision.noneDetected: No objects detected above the confidence threshold — try another image.

lead-scraper-enrichment.name: Scraping & Enrichment
lead-scraper-enrichment.description: Pulling structured data out of unstructured web sources and enriching it with the context that makes it usable — company, role, recent activity — not just raw scraped rows.

invoice-ocr-pipeline.name: Document & Receipt OCR
invoice-ocr-pipeline.description: Turning photos and PDFs of receipts, invoices, and forms into clean, structured, exportable data — no manual retyping.

content-repurposing.name: Content Automation
content-repurposing.description: Breaking one piece of long-form content into platform-ready drafts automatically — transcript in, threads and captions out.

data-qa-audit.name: Data Auditing
data-qa-audit.description: Rule-based and LLM-based checks that catch bad records at scale, with a measurable accuracy score instead of a gut feeling.

api-workflow-integration.name: Backend Integrations
api-workflow-integration.description: Connecting the tools you already use so information moves between them automatically instead of being copy-pasted by hand.

custom-vision-model.name: Computer Vision
custom-vision-model.description: Training a model on your specific images when off-the-shelf OCR or object detection isn't accurate enough for the job.

Packages.listDescription: Each one has a defined scope and turnaround. No price is shown here — pick the one that matches what you need, submit a request, and you'll hear back with a price and a timeline.
Packages.noPriceNote: No price is shown here — submit a request and I'll reply with a price and timeline.

lead-scraper-enrichment.name: Custom Lead Scraper + Enrichment List
lead-scraper-enrichment.pitch: Scrape a defined source, enrich records, hand back a clean list.
lead-scraper-enrichment.whatItIs: You give me a defined source and the criteria that matter — I build a one-off scrape-and-enrich pass and hand back a clean, ready-to-use list instead of raw scraped rows.
whatsIncluded: Scrape of one clearly defined source against your criteria
Enrichment of each record with the context that makes it usable
A clean, deduplicated export (spreadsheet or CSV)
lead-scraper-enrichment.input: A defined source (URLs or a site) plus your criteria

invoice-ocr-pipeline.name: Receipt/Invoice OCR Pipeline Setup
invoice-ocr-pipeline.whatItIs: A one-time setup that turns photos or PDFs of receipts and invoices into structured, exportable line items — no more retyping totals by hand.
whatsIncluded: Pipeline configured for your receipt/invoice format
invoice-ocr-pipeline.input: Receipt or invoice photos and PDFs
invoice-ocr-pipeline.output: Structured line items (vendor, amount, date, category) as CSV

content-repurposing.name: Content Repurposing Automation
content-repurposing.whatItIs: Feed in one raw video or transcript and get back a batch of platform-ready drafts — no more manually reformatting the same idea five different ways.
whatsIncluded: Transcription + key-idea breakdown of one source video/recording
Platform-ready drafts (threads, captions, a newsletter blurb)
One round of revisions on the draft set
content-repurposing.output: Platform-ready drafts: threads, captions, newsletter blurb

data-qa-audit.name: Small-Scope Data QA/Audit Script
data-qa-audit.pitch: Rule + LLM-based checking of a defined dataset, with a measurable accuracy score.
data-qa-audit.whatItIs: A script that checks a defined dataset against rules and an LLM-based review pass, so you get a measurable accuracy score instead of a gut feeling about your data quality.
whatsIncluded: Rule-based + LLM-based checks against your dataset
A flagged-records report with a measurable accuracy score
The script itself, so you can re-run it later
data-qa-audit.input: A dataset plus your validation rules
data-qa-audit.output: Flagged-records report with accuracy score, and the re-runnable script

api-workflow-integration.name: Custom API/Workflow Integration
api-workflow-integration.pitch: Connect 2+ tools/systems with a custom automation script.
api-workflow-integration.whatItIs: I connect two or more tools you already use with a custom automation script, so information moves between them on its own instead of being copy-pasted by hand.
whatsIncluded: Integration script connecting your specified tools/systems
Basic error handling and a run log
Handoff notes on how it works
api-workflow-integration.input: The tools or systems to connect, and what should move between them
api-workflow-integration.output: Integration script with error handling, run log, and handoff notes

custom-vision-model.name: Custom-Trained Vision Model (small scope)
custom-vision-model.pitch: A bespoke computer-vision model when off-the-shelf OCR/CV isn't accurate enough.
custom-vision-model.whatItIs: When general-purpose OCR or object detection isn't accurate enough for your specific images, I train a small-scope custom vision model against your actual data instead.
whatsIncluded: Model trained against a sample of your images
An accuracy report against a held-out test set
Delivery notes on how to run/integrate it
custom-vision-model.input: A sample set of your images
custom-vision-model.output: Trained model, accuracy report on held-out images, and run/integrate notes

About.metaDescription: IxMa Operations is a one-engineer practice run by Emilio Ramirez: scraping pipelines, document and vision models, data QA, and API integrations, handed off with full code ownership.
About.title: One engineer. No agency layers.
About.description: IxMa Operations is my practice — I'm Emilio Ramirez. I build scraping pipelines, document and vision models, data QA, and API integrations for individuals, small teams, and growing businesses. The person who scopes your project is the person who builds it.
About.storyTitle: Built because the usual options kept breaking
About.storyP1: Most automation work I saw fell into two camps: buried under agency layers where the person selling it never touched the code, or held together with no-code glue that broke the first time a source changed its layout.
About.storyP2: I started IxMa Operations to do it the other way. I build the pipeline once, test it against messy real data, and hand over the full codebase so it keeps running without me. You talk to me from the first email to the last commit.
About.philosophyDescription: I avoid fragile automations and agency overhead. Everything I deliver is meant to run deterministically in production, on your infrastructure.

deterministic.title: Deterministic & Production-Grade
deterministic.description: No brittle scripts or hallucinating prompts. I build verifiable pipelines with strict type validation, automated tests, and structured error handling.

direct.title: Direct Engineer Access
direct.description: You work with me, the engineer designing and building your system. Fast feedback loops, transparent scoping, and no account managers.

turnaround.title: Predictable & Fast Turnaround
turnaround.description: Scope is clear from day one, with typical delivery in 2–5 days for pre-scoped packages and clear milestones for custom architectures.

ownership.title: 100% Code & Asset Ownership
ownership.description: You own all code, trained weights, scripts, and documentation. Containerized and clean, designed to run on your infrastructure.

About.stackDescription: Proven, maintainable tools — nothing exotic that you'd struggle to hand to your own team later.
About.focusDescription: The technical areas where precision, speed, and accuracy create immediate operational leverage.

scraping.title: Web Extraction & Enrichment
scraping.description: Extracting structured data from complex sources with anti-bot resilience, schema validation, and intelligent entity enrichment.

ocr.title: Vision & Document Intelligence
ocr.description: Converting receipts, invoices, and legacy documents into structured data using fine-tuned OCR and layout-aware models.

workflow.title: Custom Backend Integrations
workflow.description: Bridging disparate APIs, databases, webhooks, and cron workers so your operations flow automatically without manual glue.

auditing.title: Data Auditing & Quality QA
auditing.description: Automated data health scoring, duplicate deduplication, format normalization, and rule-based validation at scale.

About.lifecycleDescription: Three steps from problem definition to working software in your hands.

step1.title: Intake & Spec
step1.description: You share the problem through the scoper or the brief form. I clarify schemas, edge cases, turnaround, and deliverables, and write them down as the spec.

step2.title: Engineering & Benchmark
step2.description: I build the pipeline or model and test it against real edge cases, noisy data, and performance benchmarks before you see it.

step3.title: Complete Codebase Handoff
step3.description: You receive the full codebase, environment configuration, and documentation, with direct support from me while you deploy.

About.founderBio: I'm a full-stack software and automation engineer focused on dependable data pipelines, applied machine learning and computer vision, and API architectures. I read every request myself, so the person who answers your first email is the one who writes the code.
About.ctaDescription: Tell me what you're trying to solve. I'll get back to you with real scope, timeline, and next steps.
